about: Where Matthew Henry's comment on each verse begins and ends (character offsets into library/commentary/MHC/1SA.json). Read-only; no text copied. relation: own / together (with the verses in 'with') / under-earlier (no separate comment; falls under 'with'[0]) / none (before his first placed verse; chapter opening). evidence: citation+quotation / citation / quotation / range-citation / none. 'specific': a nested point treating this verse in particular, when one exists. 'textSha256' guards against the commentary changing under the index. Built by tools/build-mhc-index.py; method in claude/henry-index-trial-nov15.md.
